metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Belgium - Belgium Lego Man
metas.note: Horizontal Zebra stripe: Austria, Belgium, Greece, Poland, Serbia. > LEGO MAN: Belgium.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/belgium for more clues.

metas.name: Bosnia - Belt + Straight Legs Croatia/Bosnia
metas.note: White Belt: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal, Germany, Hungary. > Non-Pointed Shoes: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal. > Straight legs: Croatia/Bosnia.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Bulgaria - 4 Stripes + Hat Bulgaria
metas.note: Hat - Austria, Bulgaria, Czechia, Slovakia. > those with 4 Zebra Stripes: Bulgaria.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bulgaria for more clues.

metas.name: Croatia - Belt + Straight Legs Croatia/Bosnia
metas.note: White Belt: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal, Germany, Hungary. > Non-Pointed Shoes: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal. > Straight legs: Croatia/Bosnia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/croatia for more clues.

metas.name: Czech - Tucked-in Czechia
metas.note: Hat - Austria, Bulgaria, Czechia, Slovakia. > Those with 5 Zebra Stripes: Czechia, Slovakia. > Extra blue border on edge and Tucked-in shirt: Czechia. White border on edge and Draping jacket at waist: Slovakia.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Denmark - 3Denmark
metas.note: Denmark's guy has a chill walking posture and has rounded edges on the person. Often found on thicker, 3D blue squares. His arms are also pointed down, unlike some similar signs found in Scandinavia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/denmark for more clues.

metas.name: Estonia - Estonia Detailed 3 Stripes
metas.note: 3 Zebra Stripes: Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, Ukraine. Neck / Shoes / Detailed outline is unique to Estonia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/estonia for more clues.

metas.name: Finland - Five Stripe Finland
metas.note: Detailed man without a hat and 5 Zebra stripes is Finland. Features both the detailed man's outline and the bold rounded, non-detailed person. Finland's bold non-detailed man with 5 zebra stripes has one arm pointed up, unlike Denmark.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/finland for more clues.

metas.name: France - Fat White Border France
metas.note: Has 2 designs, one of them has no bent elbow on the left arm which is unique to France. The other is the standard Italy-styled one, but French pedestrian signs all share a fat white border not found elsewhere.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/france for more clues.

metas.name: Germany - Flat-Arm-on-Inside Germany
metas.note: White Belt: Croatia, Portugal, Germany, Hungary. > Pointed Shoes: Germany, Hungary. > Germany Belt: Above hip. Hungary Belt: Bottom of hip. Germany arm: Flat side on left. Hungary arm: Flat side on right.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/germany for more clues.

metas.name: Greece - Greece
metas.note: Horizontal Zebra stripe: Austria, Belgium, Greece, Poland, Serbia. > Detailed guy with no hat: Greece. Note that Greece's icon has hair that may almost look like a hat but it's just hair. Kinda looks like the Dame Tu Cosita guy
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/greece for more clues.

metas.name: Hungary - Flat-Arm-on-Outside Hungary
metas.note: White Belt: Croatia, Portugal, Germany, Hungary. > Pointed Shoes: Germany, Hungary. > Germany Belt: Above hip. Hungary Belt: Bottom of hip. Germany arm: Flat side on left. Hungary arm: Flat side on right.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/hungary for more clues.

metas.name: Iceland - Yellow Iceland
metas.note: Iceland is the only sign with a yellow triangle instead of white.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/iceland for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Blue-Corners Italy
metas.note: Italy, Romania, Serbia, and Slovenia all look about the same. Thankfully Romania will not have a white/silver border. Italy will have blue corners visible outside the white edge.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Latvia - Long Leg Latvia
metas.note: You can identify Latvia from their guy with weirdly long legs. Long as hell for what. It's arguable Russia/Ukraine/Lithuania has long legs but even so they have 3 zebra stripes, not 5.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/latvia for more clues.

metas.name: Lithuania - Lithuania Fatty
metas.note: 3 Zebra Stripes: Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, Ukraine. > Cross off Estonia and Russia (detailed guy in Estonia, Yellow borders in Russia) and you're left with Lithuania and Ukraine. Lithuania's guy is a liiittle bit more fat in the torso than Ukraine and the blue is generally more vibrant than Ukraine.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/lithuania for more clues.

metas.name: Netherlands - Zeester
metas.note: Netherlands' guy has funny limbs, they shrink towards the end sorta like a starfish.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/netherlands for more clues.

metas.name: Norway - Norway
metas.note: 4 Zebra Stripes: Norway, Sweden, Bulgaria. > Bold, non-detailed person: only Norway.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/norway for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Poland
metas.note: Horizontal Zebra stripe: Austria, Belgium, Greece, Poland, Serbia. > Single & continuous line: Only Poland.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Portugal - Belt + Bent Knees Portugal
metas.note: White Belt: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal, Germany, Hungary. > Non-Pointed Shoes: Croatia/Bosnia, Portugal. Bent knees: Portugal.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/portugal for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Romania
metas.note: Italy, Romania, Serbia, and Slovenia all look about the same. Thankfully Romania will not have a white/silver border.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Russia - Russia
metas.note: 3 Zebra Stripes: Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, Ukraine. > Russia is the only one with yellow borders.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Serbia - Switch-up Serbia
metas.note: Serbia has 2 different pedestrian signs. Horizontal Zebra stripe: Austria, Belgium, Greece, Poland, Serbia. > No hat + rounded, non-detailed guy: Serbia. OR 5 Zebra stripes + rounded guy + no belt + white/silver border + no blue corners: Serbia, and Slovenia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/serbia for more clues.

metas.name: Slovakia - Hanging Jacket Slovakia
metas.note: Hat - Austria, Bulgaria, Czechia, Slovakia. > Those with 5 Zebra Stripes: Czechia, Slovakia. > Extra blue border on edge and Tucked-in shirt: Czechia. White border on edge and Draping jacket at waist: Slovakia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/slovakia for more clues.

metas.name: Slovenia - Slovenia
metas.note: Italy, Romania, Serbia, and Slovenia all look about the same. Thankfully Romania will not have a white/silver border. Italy will have blue corners visible outside the white edge.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/slovenia for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Bola Ocho
metas.note: Spain has a whopping 8 zebra stripes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Sweden - Swedish Gyatt
metas.note: 4 Zebra Stripes: Norway, Sweden, Bulgaria. > Detailed man without a hat: only Sweden. Personally I easily identify Sweden from the gyatt
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/sweden for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Extra Height Turkey
metas.note: Turkey's sign has extra blue space above the triangle compared to the rest.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Skinny Ukraine
metas.note: 3 Zebra Stripes: Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, Ukraine. > Cross off Estonia and Russia (detailed guy in Estonia, Yellow borders in Russia) and you're left with Lithuania and Ukraine. Lithuania's guy is a liiittle bit more fat in the torso than Ukraine and the blue is generally more vibrant than Ukraine.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.
